requirements_summary: Workloads: chat-first customer support + embeddings for doc search; reranking to surface top docs in UI.
SLOs: interactive chat p99 < 500ms; embeddings generation within 2s per request typical at current volume.
Cost: target avg $0.9-$1.2 per 1k tokens equivalent (early benchmark); looking for batching/caching advice to reduce unit cost.
Security: SOC2 evidence, SSO/SAML for team access, audit logs, optional KMS integration; DPA & data residency discussion for EU customers later.
Operational: simple SDK, streaming chat, function-calling not critical now but interest in structured outputs for downstream systems.
Rollout plan: 2-week POC -> decide on hosted vs dedicated proof points; if compliant, expand usage over 3-6 months.
